name: 55720 · Cloquet, MN
findings: ZIP 55720 (Cloquet) has 73 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (27%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 55720 (Cloquet) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 55720 (Cloquet) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 69% of the typical level).

observations.text: 12 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
